text:
jamie: heads-up from support 10: customer reported being charged twice when a live stream triggered a toolcall mid-stream, then the client reconnected and resumed. both the toolcall and the resumed stream appear billed for overlapping token ranges

olivia: route/trace? any quick repro? :thinking_face:

jamie: traces: 0xfeed01 / 0xfeed02. route=router-eu-mux, session=cli-9987. ledger shows a confirmed toolcall row followed by a confirmed stream row with intersecting offsets

sandeep: can you paste the ledger fragment? sounds like a dedupe key didn't survive the handoff

jamie: snippet below:
```
ledger_row ts=1671000123 session=cli-9987 kind=toolcall tokens=28 tool=kb-search charge=confirmed offset_span=[100..127]
ledger_row ts=1671000138 session=cli-9987 kind=stream tokens=10 offset_start=118 charge=provisional
ledger_row ts=1671000142 session=cli-9987 kind=stream tokens=20 offset_start=118 charge=confirmed
```

jamie: router moved the resumed connection to another backend for load balancing; our ledger dedupe is backend-scoped (toolcall_id + session) so new backend didn't see the earlier toolcall row

maria: that's a cross-backend dedupe blindspot. mux overlay intentionally rebalances for perf, but that breaks our current dedupe model when toolcalls finalize after a handoff

olivia: short-term ops idea: surface a console annotation when provisional/confirmed stream rows have token-range intersection with toolcalls for same session. add a one-click "revert charge" for ops to issue credits while we fix infra

sandeep: infra proposal: have the router attach a lightweight global_session_id at handshake that persists across backend swaps. ledger confirm writes check (global_session_id + offset_span) for duplicates before inserting confirmed charges

jamie: two implementation caveats: (1) we must avoid high-cardinality keys and index bloat, (2) tombstone/TLL races where toolcall anchor expires before stream finalizes

sandeep: agree. propose global_session_id be low-entropy (one per client session), keep dedupe entries with short TTL aligned to session keepalive (e.g., 4-6 minutes), and write tombstones on toolcall confirm with configurable TTL per customer tier

maria: telemetry/UX ask: we need a dashboard tile that counts "token-overlap incidents" by route, backend, and plan tier. current metrics only show token counts and error rates, not span intersections

olivia: also add a canary toggle on the mux overlay rollout so we can prevent cross-backend handoffs for sessions that have in-flight toolcalls until the dedupe path ships

sandeep: longer-term checklist:
- router: emit global_session_id in handshake and retain across reconnections
- ledger: dedupe check on confirm by (global_session_id, offset_span)
- tombstone index: configurable TTL, per-customer rate limits to avoid retention blow-up
- console: overlap alerting, link to raw ledger slice + traces, rollback action for ops

billing-bot: automated note: 1 impacted customer, ~48 tokens double-billed. ticket INC-4751 opened.

jamie: i'll attach the extra traces to INC-4751 and collect a few more samples for the runbook. mari to prototype dashboard query and rollback UX, sandeep to spike global_id POC, olivia to add mux canary flag

maria: will mock a dashboard card and a support flow that links to the raw ledger rows so ops can validate before applying refunds

jamie: thanks. please post updates here. prefer short canary rollout so we can validate the mitigation before broad enabling. :thumbsup:
